messages.subject: shinyRGL bug
parts:
Hi!

Since l updated to the lateast versions of RStudio, Shiny and R I get the error

"Error in tag("div", list(...)) : could not find function "webGLOutput""

despite having library(shinyRGL) in server.R (among many other libraries at the top of the file). The error disappears if I manually type in 'library(shinyRGL)' and execute it in RStudio. 
The shinyRGL-package doesn't seem to updated since 2013 so I might as well ask if there is an alternative and easy way to include rgl output with shiny.

/Christian
